thread:
maria: quick mid-sprint blitz — sharing status + blockers from kernel + kv improvements. TL;DR: need review on PR #4892, kernel perf regression on main->canary, and kv prefetch heuristic is misfiring for long tails. owners listed below.

jake: reading. short updates: kernel PR #4892 is ready for review, perf tests failing on 512-token batch for one path. exp logs below.

jake: ```
perf: baseline 22ms/token, canary 29ms/token (path A)
trace: stalls at kv-lookup when seq_len > 384
```

sunil: noted. I'm owner for kernel path A. reproducing locally now. if it's kv lookup, could be lock contention on sharded map — will instrument.

kai: KV prefetch: we saw a mismatch in hit ratio after enabling async prefetch for long sequences. heuristic currently prefetch when prefix_len >= 128; might be too aggressive.

lina: ops-bot reported 3 autoscaler cooldowns yesterday during the canary wave (region us-west2). maybe correlated with the regression. ops-bot: autoscale:3 events, avg latency spike 18%

maria: action items: 1) @jake open a smaller PR to gate the new kernel path behind a feature flag (so canary can stay green) 2) @sunil add lock metrics + flamegraph link 3) @kai tune prefetch threshold and run canary with traffic replay 4) @lina coordinate a short maintenance window if canary needs rollback.

jake: will open the gate PR in ~30m. pinging reviewers @sunil @kai.

sunil: instrumented and pushed traces to the perf dashboard: https://perf.internal/redwood/trace/4780 (heatmap + stack samples). initial suspect: a double-copy in path A on attention kv build.

kai: trying a conservative tweak: prefetch threshold -> 256 and max_prefetch_windows -> 2; running perf harness now.

kai: quick note — this change reduces prefetch traffic by ~60% in replay but increases miss latency for a tiny subset (seq>1024). need to weigh.

lina: ops team can hold off rollback for ~2 hours if we keep monitoring; set an alert on region latency > 15% and error rate > 0.5%. I'll keep on watch.

maria: also need clarity on ownership for follow-up tasks: kernel path owner = @sunil, gating + PR -> @jake, kv heuristic -> @kai, rollout ops -> @lina. if anyone wants to swap, speak now.

sunil: fine with that ownership. I'll draft a short follow-up doc outlining the lock redesign ideas and a couple of microbenchmarks.

jake: gate PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/4901 (small flag + tests). added reviewers.

kai: perf harness results: canary replay latency down to +3% (from +18%), cache hit ratio stable-ish. pushing a canary with gated kernel path + tuned prefetch in us-west2.

maria: thanks. final ask — if the gated canary holds for 30m with no >12% spike, we do phased rollout. please post the final canary verdict here. I'll update the sprint board with the blocker cleared or blocked accordingly.

ops-bot: Alert subscription: eng-runtime-monitoring now watching canary. Will post if thresholds breached.

lina: monitoring steady at +4% latency after changes, no errors. holding for the 30m window.

maria: awesome. i'll mark milestone note: kernel-canary-held-temporarily. next sync: async update in #eng-runtime at EOD. thanks all. :thumbsup:
